title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Atractylis seed shifts from a morphological comparator to a recipe ingredient
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. In Lonitzer's complete Atractylis entry, 'Semen Cnici figura' describes the seed through a Cnicus-form comparison; later, the same named plant part, semen, is included with leaves and coma among materials crushed with pepper and wine and taken against scorpion stings (attributed to Dioscorides). Keep the seed's description role separate from its recipe-ingredient role. This source relation is not a Voynich gloss or a medical claim.

whole_source.locator: ATRACTYLIS complete entry: morphological clause 'Semen Cnici figura'; later VIRES, INTRINSECUS: 'Atractylidis folia, coma et semen, trita, cum pipere vinoque pota, contra scorpionum ictus prosunt, teste Dioscoride.'
whole_source.layer: CAMENA typed edition of Lonitzer, 1551, preserved in F_COMPLETE_ENTRIES.md; not a fully corrected diplomatic transcription.

design.content_hypothesis: The same named part is assigned two distinct relations in the same entry: seed-as-form comparison and seed-as-one-ingredient in a crushed, pepper-and-wine preparation taken for a stated purpose. Preserve its part identity while not treating the descriptive comparison as an ingredient or recipe as morphology.
design.contrast: A whole-entry account must keep the descriptive figure clause apart from the later preparation/use clause. The latter states the seed together with leaves and coma; it does not license seed-only dosing or an independent effect for seed alone.
design.smallest_next_authoring_object: If selected later, nominate a whole already-authorized target passage with independently fixed description and recipe roles. No target token or value is proposed here.
strongest_limits: Typed edition layer, not diplomatic witness collation.
The source does not specify an amount, and the medicinal claim is attributed rather than endorsed.
No Voynich meaning or target test is selected.
design.claim_ceiling: One source-grounded RAW_UNREVIEWED proposal; no target interpretation.
